RunAsh AI - LLM Integration Notes

- Primary app: Next.js (App Router) repository for RunAsh AI.
- Main integration surfaces:
  - API routes under app/api
  - Service logic under services and lib/services
  - Agentic features under lib/agentic-protocol.ts and related UI/components
- Before introducing new model providers or prompts:
  - document configuration in README and relevant guide
  - avoid hardcoding provider secrets
  - keep model-specific behavior behind service abstractions
